ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p427/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p427/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p427/r1.claim: The opponents want Muhammad to soften his position so they can make reciprocal concessions; their opposition is bargaining against desire, not sincere commitment to religion.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p427/r1.anchor: they have no doubt in the veracity of what he says; however, accepting it is against their desires

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p427/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p427/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p427/r2.claim: The verse’s syntax suppresses the inchoative; the full sense is “they too will soften,” after the Prophet softens his stance.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p427/r2.anchor: it is their desire that the Prophet (sws) softens his stance and then they too will soften their attitude

QUSHAYRI:v3p342/r3.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p342/r3.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p342/r3.claim: Those urging compromise wish everyone to share their sickness, just as those marked by separation wish opponents to experience it too.
QUSHAYRI:v3p342/r3.anchor: من أصبح عليلا تمنى أن يكون الناس كلهم مرضى

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r5.claim: Basran grammarians take لو as a verbal noun equivalent to أن; most instead supply an omitted object after “they wished,” leaving لو as a counterfactual particle with omitted consequence.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r5.anchor: ومذهب الجمهور أن معمول ود محذوف،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r6.speaker: ابن عباس والضحاك وعطية والسدي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r6.claim: They interpret “you soften” as “you disbelieve,” so the opponents would persist in their own disbelief.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r6.anchor: وقال ابن عباس والضحاك وعطية والسدي: لو تدهن: لو تكفر، فيتمادون على كفرهم.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r7.claim: Another report from Ibn ʿAbbās says the opponents wanted concessions from the Prophet so that they could make concessions in return.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r7.anchor: وعن ابن عباس أيضا: لو ترخص لهم فيرخصون لك.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r8.speaker: قتادة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r8.claim: Qatāda says they wanted the Prophet to abandon this mission so they would go along with him.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r8.anchor: وقال قتادة: لو تذهب عن هذا الأمر فيذهبون معك.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r9.speaker: الحسن
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r9.claim: Al-Ḥasan says they wanted compromise in religion, with each side compromising for the other.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r9.anchor: وقال الحسن: لو تصانعهم في دينك فيصانعوك في دينهم.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r10.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r10.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam explains the request as hypocrisy and mutual display of piety.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r10.anchor: وقال زيد بن أسلم: لو تنافق وترائي فينافقونك ويراؤونك.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r11.speaker: الربيع بن أنس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r11.claim: Al-Rabīʿ ibn Anas says they wanted the Prophet to lie, so they would lie in return.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r11.anchor: وقال الربيع بن أنس: لو تكذب فيكذبون.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r12.speaker: أبو جعفر
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r12.claim: Abū Jaʿfar says they wanted the Prophet to weaken, so they would weaken too.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r12.anchor: وقال أبو جعفر: لو تضعف فيضعفون.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r13.speaker: الكلبي والفراء
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r13.claim: Al-Kalbī and al-Farrāʾ interpret the request as “be gentle,” so they too would be gentle.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r13.anchor: وقال الكلبي والفراء: لو تلين فيلينون.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r14.speaker: أبان بن ثعلب
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r14.claim: Abān ibn Thaʿlab interprets it as mutual favoritism.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r14.anchor: وقال أبان بن ثعلب: لو تحابي فيحابون،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r15.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r15.speaker: الفراء
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r15.claim: Al-Farrāʾ defines dihān as softening; al-Mufaḍḍal says hypocrisy and abandoning sincere advice, which Abū Ḥayyān treats as within the lexical range.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r15.anchor: وقال الفراء: الدهان: التليين. وقال المفضل: النفاق وترك المناصحة،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r16.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r16.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r16.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī parses the second clause as an omitted predicate: they would soften then, due to hoping the Prophet softened, or they are already doing so.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r16.anchor: وهو أن جعل خبر مبتدأ محذوف، أي فهم يدهنون كقوله:

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r17.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r17.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r17.claim: Most codices retain the nūn in فيدهنون; Hārūn reports a form without it in which the verb is subjunctive as a wished-for result or by implication of أن.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r17.anchor: وجمهور المصاحف على إثبات النون. وقال هارون: إنه في بعض المصاحف فيدهنوا،

TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r5.claim: The deniers want the Prophet to soften his religion by drawing near to them, so they will reciprocate by compromising theirs; the author understands the desire as covering both parts of the phrase and the fa as elaborating consequence.
TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r5.anchor: أن تلينهم بالاقتراب منهم في دينك فيلينوك بالاقتراب منك في دينهم

TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r6.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r6.claim: One reported proposal was that the Prophet stop mentioning their idols and they would leave him and his Lord alone.
TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r6.anchor: كما قيل إنهم عرضوا عليه أن يكف عن ذكر آلهتهم فيكفوا عنه وعن ربه

ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r6.claim: The deniers called the Prophet deluded or misguided out of malice and wished him to flatter them by leaving their idols and injustices unchallenged; had he accommodated them, they would have flattered and affirmed his falsehoods.
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r6.anchor: Zira {وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ} arzu ettiler ki sen müdahene etsen, onları

ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r7.speaker: author
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r7.claim: The first foundation of noble character is to refuse obedience to the deniers and avoid flattering their aims; compromising tongues and pens are far from moral greatness and reason.
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r7.anchor: İşte büyük ahlâkın ilk umdesi budur

BINTSHATI:v2p56/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r1.claim: Traditional grammar makes the verb subjunctive after a wish because waddu law carries the sense of layta.
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r1.anchor: النصب في جواب التمني {وَدُّوا لَوْ} لتضمنه معنى ليت.

BINTSHATI:v2p56/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r2.speaker: الزمخشري
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r2.claim: Al-Zamakhshari accounts for the indicative wording by supplying a deleted predicate or reading it as a verbal noun construction.
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r2.anchor: قال الزمخشري: " عدل به عن ذلك إلى طريق آخر هو على تقدير خبر مبتدأ محذوف: فهم يدهنون. أو على المصدرية، المؤولة،

BINTSHATI:v2p56/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r3.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r3.claim: Some codices reportedly read yudhinū without the nūn, with grammarians analyzing it either as a wish’s subjunctive response or as if an were spoken.
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r3.anchor: ثم أشار إلى قراءة في بعض المصاحف بحذف النون: "فيدهنوا"

BINTSHATI:v2p56/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r4.speaker: أبو حيان
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r4.claim: Abu Hayyan says the majority of codices retain the nūn.
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r4.anchor: وجمهور المصاحف على إثبات النون كما صرح أبو حيان في (البحر)

BINTSHATI:v2p56/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r5.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r5.claim: The author says revelation is the grammatical authority: the fāʾ coordinates yudhinūn with tudhinu, keeping the indicative nūn and the causal nuance.
BINTSHATI:v2p56/r5.anchor: وتكون الفاء في: فيدهنون حرف عطف، فتثبت النون رفعاً بالعطن على {تُدْهِنُ} والفاء العاطفة لا تفقد ملحظ السببية.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r3.claim: Tudhinu means to soften, accommodate, or compromise, and fa-yudhinūn means that they would then compromise.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r3.anchor: لو تلين وتصانع { فيدهنون } فإن قلت : لم رفع

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r4.claim: The raised fa-yudhinūn is not subjunctive as a response to the wish; the construction instead predicates a deleted subject, “then they would compromise,” or says they compromise now in hope of his accommodation.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r4.anchor: وهو أن جعل خبر مبتدأ محذوف ، أي : فهم يدهنون

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r5.speaker: سيبويه
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r5.claim: Sībawayh reports that Hārūn said some codices have the variant “they wished you to compromise, so they would compromise.”
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r5.anchor: قال سيبويه : وزعم هرون أنها في بعض المصاحف ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنوا

TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r8.claim: The opponents wished Muhammad would soften his religion so they would soften theirs.
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r8.anchor: شبه التليين في الدين بتليين الدهن عن ابن عباس

TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r9.speaker: الضحاك وعطاء وابن عباس في رواية أخرى
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r9.claim: Another interpretation is that they wished Muhammad would disbelieve so that they too could disbelieve.
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r9.anchor: وقيل: معناه ودوا لو تكفر فيكفرون عن الضحاك وعطاء وابن عباس في رواية أخرى

TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r10.speaker: author
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r10.claim: They wanted him to incline toward idol worship so they could accommodate him; “softening” describes outward rapprochement while hiding hostility.
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r10.anchor: وقيل: معناه ودوا لو تركن إلى عبادة الأصنام فيمالئونك والإدهان الجريان

TABRISI:68:1-16#5/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:68:1-16#5/r1.speaker: الحسن
TABRISI:68:1-16#5/r1.claim: Al-Ḥasan interprets their wish as reciprocal accommodation in religion.
TABRISI:68:1-16#5/r1.anchor: وقيل: ودوا لو تصانعهم في دينك فيصانعونك عن الحسن

RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r1.speaker: الليث
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r1.claim: Al-Layth explains idhān as softness, accommodation, and speaking in an accommodating manner.
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r1.anchor: الإدهان اللين والمصانعة والمقاربة في الكلام

RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r2.speaker: المبرد
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r2.claim: Al-Mubarrad says one practices idhān in religion or affairs by betraying them while displaying the opposite of one’s intent.
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r2.anchor: داهن الرجل في دينه وداهن في أمره

RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r3.claim: The proposed compromise is that Muhammad abandon some of his commitments to please them, and they in turn abandon what displeases him.
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r3.anchor: تترك بعض ما أنت عليه مما لا يرضونه

RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r4.claim: ʿAṭāʾ transmits Ibn ʿAbbās’s interpretation: they wished Muhammad would disbelieve so that they would disbelieve.

RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r5.claim: The verb is nominative rather than subjunctive after the wish because the syntax shifts to an omitted subject’s predicate: they would then accommodate; compare 72:13.
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r5.anchor: ولم ينصب بإضمار أن وهو جواب التمني

RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r6.speaker: هارون
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#3/r6.claim: Sībawayh reports that the reader Hārūn claimed some codices read the verb in the subjunctive, yudhinū.

STUDYQURAN:68:9/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r1.claim: Dāhana can mean “to demean,” “to deny,” or “to take something lightly.”
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r1.anchor: Compromise translates the verb dahana, which can mean both “to demean” and “to deny” or “to take something lightly.”

STUDYQURAN:68:9/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r2.claim: One reading has the disbelievers ready to compromise if the Prophet and his followers compromise; another has them already compromising and wanting believers to do likewise.
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r2.anchor: will compromise when the Prophet and his followers compromise or that the disbelievers are already compromising; so they want the believers to compromise too (Z)

STUDYQURAN:68:9/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r3.speaker: Bg
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r3.claim: On the first reading, disbelievers would trade concessions in religion or take turns worshipping one another’s gods.
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r3.anchor: that the believers worship their gods for a while and then they worship the believers’ God for a while (Bg)

STUDYQURAN:68:9/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r4.speaker: Bg
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r4.claim: On the second reading, the disbelievers want believers to become disbelievers too.
STUDYQURAN:68:9/r4.anchor: it means that they are disbelievers; so they wish for believers to become disbelievers as well (Bg)

TAB-FULL:v23p156/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r1.claim: In one reported interpretation, the deniers wished Muhammad would disbelieve so they too could disbelieve.
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس، قوله: {لو تدهن فيدهنون} [القلم: 9] يقول: ودوا لو تكفر فيكفرون

TAB-FULL:v23p156/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r2.speaker: الضحاك
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r2.claim: Al-Dahhak gives the same reading: they wanted Muhammad to disbelieve so they would disbelieve.
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r2.anchor: الضحاك، يقول في قوله: {ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون} [القلم: 9] قال: تكفر فيكفرون

TAB-FULL:v23p156/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r3.speaker: سفيان
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r3.claim: Sufyan also understands the request as wishing Muhammad would disbelieve, allowing them to disbelieve.
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r3.anchor: عن سفيان: {ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون} [القلم: 9] قال: تكفر فيكفرون

TAB-FULL:v23p156/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r4.claim: A second interpretation from Ibn Abbas is that they wanted him to make concessions so they could make concessions too.
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r4.anchor: عن ابن عباس، قوله: {لو تدهن فيدهنون} [القلم: 9] يقول: لو ترخص لهم فيرخصون

TAB-FULL:v23p156/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r5.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r5.claim: Mujahid says they wanted Muhammad to incline toward their idols and abandon the truth they asked him to leave.
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r5.anchor: عن مجاهد، قوله: {ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون} [القلم: 9] قال: لو تركن إلى آلهتهم

TAB-FULL:v23p156/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r6.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r6.claim: Qatada says they wished Muhammad would soften his stance on the matter, after which they would soften theirs.
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r6.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله: {ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون} [القلم: 9] يقول: ودوا يا محمد لو أدهنت عن هذا الأمر

TAB-FULL:v23p156/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r7.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r7.claim: Al-Tabari prefers that the polytheists wanted Muhammad to soften in religion by leaning toward their idols; he supports this with 17:75, where he nearly inclined toward them.
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r7.anchor: وأولى القولين في ذلك بالصواب قول من قال: معنى ذلك: ود هؤلاء المشركون يا محمد لو تلين لهم في دينك

TAB-FULL:v23p156/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r8.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r8.claim: The wording derives from oil; softening speech is likened to making oil soft.
TAB-FULL:v23p156/r8.anchor: وإنما هو مأخوذ من الدهن شبه التليين في القول بتليين الدهن

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r1.claim: The Persian admonitory verse says that words without deeds are false, a sleeper cannot awaken another sleeper, and counsel must be heard attentively.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r1.anchor: كفت عالم بكوش جان بشنو ور نماند بكفتنش كردار باطلست آنكه مدعى كويد

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r2.claim: Once the foregoing is clear, the Prophet must persist in refusing their demand that he stop confronting them; he is ordered to stand firm despite his small following and their large numbers.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r2.anchor: فدم على ما أنت عليه من عدم طاعتهم فيما يدعونك إليه من الكف عنهم

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r3.claim: The verse shows that obeying a disobedient person is itself disobedience, and yielding to a tyrant is transgression.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r3.anchor: دلت الآية على أن الإطاعة للعاصي عصيان والافتداء بالطاغي طغيان

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r4.claim: Law is optative here; idhān, originally akin to oiling and derived from oil, means leniency, accommodation, or abandoning a firm position.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r4.anchor: لو للتمني والإدهان في الأصل مثل التدهين واشتقاقهما من الدهن

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r5.claim: Their hoped-for response is that they would then refrain from attacking or criticizing the Prophet.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r5.anchor: أي فهم يداهنونك حينئذ بترك الطعن

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r6.claim: On one parsing, fa coordinates yad-hinūna with the optative clause, so it stays indicative rather than losing nūn as a subjunctive result.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r6.anchor: فالفاء للعطف على تدهن فيكون يدهنون داخلا في حيز لو

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r7.claim: Alternatively, fa marks consequence: they would accommodate him as a result of his accommodating them; the verb can also describe their present flattery in hope of his compromise.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r7.anchor: أو الفاء للسببية فهو مسبب ن تدهن ويجوز أن يكون الفعل للحال

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r8.speaker: الكاشفي
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r8.claim: Al-Kāshifī paraphrases the verse as a refusal to obey polytheists who invite the Prophet to his forefathers' religion; they want him to soften his criticism of their idolatry so they will reciprocate and stop taunting his faith.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r8.anchor: كما قال الكاشفي) : فرمان مبر مشركان كه راكه ترا بدين آباء

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r9.speaker: بعضهم
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r9.claim: Some advise that outward conduct should agree with inward conviction; outward compliance without inward agreement becomes fleeting hypocrisy and dissimulation.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r9.anchor: قال بعضهم لا توافقهم في الظاهر كما لا توافقهمفي الباطن

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r10.claim: The opponents, immersed in vice and shifting desires, flatter in turn and add this vice to their others, hoping the Prophet will reciprocate their compromise.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r10.anchor: أما هم فلانهماكهم في الرذائل وتعمقهم في التلون والاختلاف لتشعب أهوائهم

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r11.speaker: بعضهم
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r11.claim: Some distinguish blameworthy mudāhana, selling religion for worldly gain, from praiseworthy mudārā, giving up worldly interest for religion.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r11.anchor: قال بعضهم المداهنة بيع الدين بالدنيا فهي من السيئات والمداراة بيع الدنيا بالدين

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r12.speaker: النبي
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r12.claim: A Prophetic saying that he was commanded to show courteous accommodation to people, just as he was commanded to convey the message, does not license improper compromise.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r12.anchor: أمرت بمداراة الناس كما أمرت بالتبليغ

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r13.speaker: الإمام الغزالي
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r13.claim: Al-Ghazālī says the motive for overlooking a fault distinguishes the two: overlooking to protect religion or reform one's brother is mudārā; doing so for self-interest, desires, or status is mudāhana.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r13.anchor: في إحياء الفرق بين المداراة والمداهنة بالغرض الباعث على الإغضاء

BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r14.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r14.speaker: أبو الدرداء
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r14.claim: Abū al-Dardāʾ says one may smile in the faces of people while the heart condemns them; Bursevī presents this as courteous accommodation toward someone whose harm is feared.
BURSEVI:v10p83#3/r14.anchor: وهذا معنى المداراة وهو مع من يخاف شره

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r2.speaker: الليث
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r2.claim: Al-Layth glosses idhān as softness and accommodation.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r3.speaker: أبو الهيثم
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r3.claim: Abū al-Haytham defines idhān as verbal accommodation and softening one’s speech.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r3.anchor: وقال أبو الهيثم: الإدهان: المقاربة في الكلام والتليين في القول

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r4.speaker: المبرد
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r4.claim: Al-Mubarrad says the related verbs describe betrayal in religion or acting outwardly against what one inwardly holds.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r4.anchor: وقال المبرد: أدهن الرجل في دينه، وداهن في أمره، إذا خان

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r5.claim: The author refers to his discussion of “you are compromising” at 56:81.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r6.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r6.claim: Al-Kalbī says they wanted the Prophet to compromise in religion so they would compromise in turn, each leaving what the other disliked.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r6.anchor: قال الكلبي: لو (¬1) تصانعهم في الدين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r7.speaker: مجاهد
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r7.claim: Mujāhid says they wanted the Prophet to incline toward them and abandon the truth, so they would side with him; this is the majority view and the meaning of al-Wālibī’s report from Ibn ʿAbbās.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r7.anchor: وهذا قول مجاهد: تركن إليهم وتترك ما أنت عليه من الحق

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r8.speaker: ابن قتيبة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r8.claim: Ibn Qutayba says they wanted the Prophet to worship their idols for a time and for them to worship God for a time.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r8.anchor: وقال ابن قتيبة: كانوا أرادوه على أن يعبدوا آلهتهم مدة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r9.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r9.claim: ʿAṭāʾ from Ibn ʿAbbās says they wanted him to disbelieve so they would disbelieve; Muqātil, ʿAṭiyya, and al-Ḍaḥḥāk give the same view, which the author treats as a form of the first compromise interpretation.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:68:4-15/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:68:4-15/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:68:4-15/r5.claim: They want Muhammad to soften his stance so that they in turn will soften theirs.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r2.claim: The unbelievers wanted the Prophet to compromise moral and spiritual principles and abandon Islamic teachings that conflicted with their interests, promising reciprocal concessions and noninterference.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r2.anchor: Hz. Peygamber’in ahlâkî prensipler ve mânevî değerler konusunda tâviz vermesini, bu anlamda uzlaşmacı davranmasını

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r3.speaker: Şevkânî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r3.claim: They proposed that the Prophet worship their idols for a time and they worship Allah, his God, for a time.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r3.anchor: bir müddet Hz. Peygamber’in onların putlarına tapmasını, bir müddet de onların Hz. Peygamber’in ilâhı olan Allah’a tapmalarını teklif etmişlerdi

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r4.claim: God requires the Prophet to remain firm without slackening: God's path is right, and truth cannot be mixed with falsehood.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r4.anchor: Hz. Peygamber’in tâvizsiz davranmasını, gevşeklik göstermemesini istemektedir. Zira doğru yol O’nun yoludur ve hak ile bâtıl birbirine karıştırılamaz

BURHAN:v2p320/r11.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p320/r11.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p320/r11.claim: The particle “if” can convey a wish with “they wished,” as in 68:9, or without it, as in the other “if only” examples.
BURHAN:v2p320/r11.anchor: والثاني لو سواء كانت مع ود كقوله تعالى ﴿ ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون ﴾ 1 بالنصب

ITQAN:v2p334#2/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p334#2/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p334#2/r1.claim: لو تدهن means “if you compromise or relax your position with them, they will compromise in return.”
ITQAN:v2p334#2/r1.anchor: ﴿ لو تدهن فيدهنون ﴾ لو ترخص لهم فيرخصون

ITQAN:v2p582/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p582/r1.speaker: بعضهم
ITQAN:v2p582/r1.claim: Some explain the reading ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنوا as equivalent in meaning to أن تدهن.
ITQAN:v2p582/r1.anchor: في قراءة / ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنوا / إنه على معنى أن تدهن

FARRA:v3p172/r7.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p172/r7.speaker: بعضهم
FARRA:v3p172/r7.claim: One view is that they wanted the Prophet to soften his religion so they would soften theirs.
FARRA:v3p172/r7.anchor: يقال: ودوا لو تلين في دينك، فيلينون في دينهم

FARRA:v3p172/r8.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p172/r8.speaker: بعضهم
FARRA:v3p172/r8.claim: Another view is that they wished him to disbelieve so they could follow him in disbelief.
FARRA:v3p172/r8.anchor: وقال بعضهم: لو تكفر فيكفرون، أي: فيتبعونك على الكفر

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p478/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p478/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p478/r1.claim: Tudhinu means to make a compromise or soften toward them in your religion; then they would soften in their religions.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p478/r1.anchor: {ودوا لو تدهن} أي: تداهن [وتلين لهم] في دينك {فيدهنون} [فيلينون] في أديانهم (3) .

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p478/r2.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p478/r2.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p478/r2.claim: They wanted the Prophet to worship their idols for a period and for them to worship God for a period.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p478/r2.anchor: وكانوا أرادوه على أن يعبد آلهتهم مدة، ويعبدوا الله مدة.

MAJAZ:v2p264/r4.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v2p264/r4.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v2p264/r4.claim: Tud’hin comes from mudāhana, acting with insincere accommodation or flattery.

NAHHAS:v5p7/r2.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p7/r2.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p7/r2.claim: فيدهنون is coordinated, not a conditional answer; if it were an answer, its nūn would be deleted.
NAHHAS:v5p7/r2.anchor: معطوف وليس بجواب ولو كان جوابا حذفت منه النون

NAHHAS:v5p7/r3.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p7/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
NAHHAS:v5p7/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās glosses the wish as: if you compromised with them, they would compromise with you.
NAHHAS:v5p7/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس ( ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون ) قال يقول لو ترخص لهم فيرخصون

NAHHAS:v5p7/r4.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p7/r4.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p7/r4.claim: They wished the Prophet would soften toward them without condemning unbelief or sins, so they would feign agreement and dare sin; such softness corrupts religion and is likened to oiling.
NAHHAS:v5p7/r4.anchor: والمعنى على هذا ودوا لو تلين لهم فلا تنكر عليهم الكفر والمعاصي

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالفاء)#475/f19.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالفاء)#475/f19.speaker: هارون
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالفاء)#475/f19.claim: Nominative in ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون is good for the wish; Hārūn reports some codices with subjunctive فيدهنوا.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالفاء)#475/f19.anchor: وزعم هارون أنها في بعض المصاحف

SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r1.claim: The common reading has raised nūn; it either coordinates with تدهن inside لو or predicates an omitted subject, فهم يدهنون.
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r1.anchor: المشهور في قراءة الناس ومصاحفهم " فيدهنون " بثبوت نون الرفع. وفيه وجهان

SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r2.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r2.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī prefers the implied-subject predicate: either they would flatter then if the Prophet did, or flatter now in hope he will.
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r2.anchor: قال الزمخشري: " فإن قلت: لم رفع " فيدهنون " ولم ينصب بإضمار " أن " وهو جواب التمني؟ قلت: قد عدل به إلى طريق آخر: وهو أن جعل خبر مبتدأ محذوف

SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r3.speaker: هارون
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r3.claim: Sībawayh reports Hārūn’s statement that some codices had subjunctive فيدهنوا.
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r3.anchor: قال سيبويه: " وزعم هارون أنها في بعض المصاحف: " ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنوا " انتهى.

SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r4.claim: For the subjunctive, one analysis coordinates by attraction to an imagined subjunctive; another makes it a response to the implied wish.
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r4.anchor: وفي نصبه على ما وجد في بعض المصاحف وجهان، أحدهما: أنه عطف على التوهم

SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r5.claim: The author takes لو as counterfactual with omitted answer; the object of ودوا is omitted as ودوا إدهانك and the answer is لسروا بذلك.
SAMIN-DURR:68:9/r5.anchor: والظاهر أن " لو " هنا حرف لما كان سيقع لوقوع غيره، وأن جوابها محذوف

ZAJJAJ:v5p205/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p205/r1.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p205/r1.claim: The opponents wished the Prophet would compromise with them in religion so they would compromise with him in return.
ZAJJAJ:v5p205/r1.anchor: أي: ودوا لو تصانعهم في الدين فيصانعونك

ASAD-NOTES:68:7#n5/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:68:7#n5/r1.speaker: Asad
ASAD-NOTES:68:7#n5/r1.claim: The opponents want ethical and moral concessions from the Prophet, promising to reciprocate and stop actively opposing him.
ASAD-NOTES:68:7#n5/r1.anchor: they would like thee to be conciliatory in the matter of ethical principles and moral valuations, whereupon they would reciprocate and desist from actively opposing thee

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p161/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p161/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p161/r1.claim: The opening verses affirm the Prophet’s mission and steady him against deniers who dispute the miracle and claim the Qur’an is merely tales of the ancients.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p161/r1.anchor: واضح أن الآيات موجهه إلى تأييد نبوة المصطفى عليه الصلاة والسلام، تثبيت قلبه في مواجهة من يكذبونه

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p308#2/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p308#2/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p308#2/r1.claim: Qatāda explains that the opponents wished the Messenger to compromise so that they would compromise in return.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p308#2/r1.anchor: عن قتادة ﴿ ودوا لو تدهن ﴾ قال ودوا لو يدهن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فيدهنون

ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r1.claim: They wish the Prophet would soften and accommodate them in some matters.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r1.anchor: أي أحبوا لو تلاينهم وتسامحهم في بعض الأمور

ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r2.claim: The result may mean they would then compromise too, or that they already compromise in hope of inducing him to do so; the ف introduces the resulting clause.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r2.anchor: أي فهم يدهنون حينئذ أو فهم الآن يدهنون طمعا في إدهانك فالفاء للسببية داخلة على جملة مسببة عما قبلها

ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r3.claim: Alternatively, فيدهنون coordinates with تدهن inside the scope of لو: they wish to compromise after he does, with sequence occurring in their wish; al-Alusi calls the preceding parses more remote amid the disputed analyses.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r3.anchor: وجوز أن تكون الفاء لعطف يدهنون على تدهن على أنه داخل معه في حيز لو متمني مثله

ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r4.speaker: هارون
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r4.claim: Some codices, as Harun reports, read فيدهنوا without the indicative ن; it may be subjunctive as the response to the wish or coordinated under a reading of لو as نصب-producing أن.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r4.anchor: وفي بعض المصاحف كما قال هارون فيدهنوا بدون نون الرفع فقيل هو منصوب في جواب التمني المفهوم من ودوا

ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r5.speaker: جمهور النحاة
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r5.claim: Most grammarians keep لو in its ordinary conditional sense, with an omitted apodosis and object of ودوا: they would be pleased if he compromised and then they would do so.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r5.anchor: وجمهور النحاة على أن لو على حقيقتها وجوابها محذوف وكذا مفعول ودوا أي ودوا إدهانك لو تدهن فيدهنون لسروا بذلك

ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r6.claim: Their compromise means showing softness while concealing the opposite; in their wish for the Prophet only outward softness counts, since they detest his concealing a contrary view.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#3/r6.anchor: فالمعتبر في جانبهم حقيقة الإدهان الذي هو إظهار الملاينة وإضمار خلافها وأما في جانبه عليه الصلاة والسلام فالمعتبر بالنسبة إلى ودادتهم هو إظهار الملاينة فقط

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r2.speaker: الضحاك
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r2.claim: Al-Dahhak explains their wish as the Prophet disbelieving so that they would disbelieve too.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r3.speaker: الكلبي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r3.claim: Al-Kalbi understands the request as mutual gentleness or accommodation.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r3.anchor: قال الكلبي: لو تلين لهم فيلينون لك

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r4.speaker: الحسن
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r4.claim: Al-Hasan says they wanted the Prophet to compromise in his religion while they compromised in theirs.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r4.anchor: قال الحسن: لو تصانعهم في دينك فيصانعونك في دينهم

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r5.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r5.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam interprets this as reciprocal hypocrisy and ostentation.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r5.anchor: قال زيد بن أسلم: لو تنافق وترائي فينافقون ويراءون

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r6.speaker: ابن قتيبة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r6.claim: Ibn Qutayba says they proposed alternating periods of worshipping their idols and worshipping God.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r6.anchor: وقال ابن قتيبة: أرادوا أن تعبد آلهتهم مدة ويعبدون الله مدة

BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r4.claim: The deniers want the Prophet to soften toward them by ceasing to forbid associating partners with God.
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r4.anchor: تلاينهم بأن تدع نهيهم عن الشرك

BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r5.claim: Another form of the requested compromise would be to agree with the deniers in shirk on some occasions.

BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r6.claim: They would reciprocate by softening their attacks and agreeing to compromise.

BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r7.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r7.claim: The fa may coordinate: they desire and defer their own compromise until the Prophet compromises first.
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r7.anchor: والفاء للعطف أي ودوا التداهن وتمنوه لكنهم أخروا ادهانهم حتى تدهن

BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r8.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r8.claim: Alternatively, the fa gives the result: if the Prophet compromised, they would then reciprocate.
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r8.anchor: أو للسببية أي { ودوا لو تدهن } فهم يدهنون حينئذ

BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r9.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r9.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r9.claim: Alternatively, they desire the Prophet's compromise and already soften their stance in expectation of it.
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r9.anchor: أو ودوا ادهانك فهم الآن يدهنون طمعا فيه

BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r10.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r10.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r10.claim: Some codices read “فيدهنوا,” treating the verb as the response to the wish.
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r10.anchor: وفي بعض المصاحف «فيدهنوا» على أنه جواب التمني

BINTSHATI:v2p54/r7.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p54/r7.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p54/r7.claim: Idhān means softness, leniency, or accommodation; mudāhana is evasive compromise or disingenuous appeasement.
BINTSHATI:v2p54/r7.anchor: والإدهان: اللين والتساهل والمداراة, والمداهنة التحايل واللاينة والمداجاة

BINTSHATI:v2p54/r8.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p54/r8.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p54/r8.claim: The root relates to oil used to soften or smooth: dahān is dye or paint, and dahīn describes a slippery place as if oiled.
BINTSHATI:v2p54/r8.anchor: وترجع استعمالات المادة وصيغها في الأصل اللغوي إلى الدهن، يتخذ للتليين والتطرية

BINTSHATI:v2p55/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r1.claim: The Qur’an’s literal oil-related sense of d-h-n appears in the examples from al-Muʾminūn and al-Raḥmān.
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r1.anchor: وفي القرآن من هذا المعنى الأول، آيتان

BINTSHATI:v2p55/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r2.claim: Idhān derives from oil and figuratively means softening or lenience, as softening speech resembles softening oil.
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r2.anchor: وبملحظ من التطرية والتلين جاءت الدلالة للإدهان، في اللين والتساهل

BINTSHATI:v2p55/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r3.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r3.claim: Mudāhana commonly describes ingratiation or cajoling involving deceit, or laxity and dereliction.
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r3.anchor: وشاع استعمال المداهنة في المداجاة والملاطفة عن غش وخداع، أو عن تساهل وتفريط

BINTSHATI:v2p55/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r4.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r4.claim: The metaphorical sense of idhān also occurs in al-Wāqiʿa 56:81, alongside this verse.
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r4.anchor: وفي القرآن من هذه الدلالة امجازية، آيتان

BINTSHATI:v2p55/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r5.speaker: قيل
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r5.claim: One reported gloss is that the opponents wanted Muhammad to make concessions so they would reciprocate with concessions.
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r5.anchor: قيل في تفسيرها: ودوا لو ترخص لهم فيرخصون لك

BINTSHATI:v2p55/r6.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r6.speaker: قيل
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r6.claim: Another gloss is that they wished him to soften his religion so they would soften theirs.
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r6.anchor: أو: ودوا لو تلين في دينك فيلينون في دينهم

BINTSHATI:v2p55/r7.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r7.speaker: قيل
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r7.claim: A further gloss is that they wanted him to lean toward their gods and abandon the truth, so they could accommodate him.
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r7.anchor: وقيل: ودوا لو تركن إلى آلهتهم وتترك ما أنت عليه من الحق فيمالئونك

BINTSHATI:v2p55/r8.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r8.speaker: الطبري
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r8.claim: Al-Ṭabarī prefers the reading that they wished Muhammad to compromise in religion by leaning toward their gods, after which they would accommodate his worship of God.

BINTSHATI:v2p55/r9.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r9.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r9.claim: Al-Ṭabarī adduces 17:74, where Muhammad nearly leaned slightly toward the opponents, as support for his interpretation.

BINTSHATI:v2p55/r10.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r10.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r10.claim: The author distinguishes idhān, the metaphor of softening speech, from mudāhana, which can mean accommodation and ingratiation.
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r10.anchor: فالإدهان مأخوذ من الدهن، شبه التليين في القول بتليين الدهن

BINTSHATI:v2p55/r11.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r11.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r11.claim: The particle law conveys the opponents’ remote, frustrated wish; exegetes and grammarians instead fixated on the retained nūn in fayudhinūna and its inflectional rule.
BINTSHATI:v2p55/r11.anchor: وشغل نحاة ومفسرون بعقد الصنعة الإعرابية

BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r7.claim: Tudhin means to soften and accommodate some of their demands, compromising by ceasing to forbid shirk, criticize their idols, or condemn their ancestors.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r7.anchor: أي تلاين فتوافق على بعض ما يريدون فتهادنهم على ترك نهيهم عن الشرك

BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r8.speaker: ابن برجان
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r8.claim: Ibn Barrajān defines idhān as accommodating falsehood and knowingly overlooking the truth.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r8.anchor: قال ابن برجان : والأدهان ملاينة وانجرار

BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r9.claim: The word idhān derives from oil because oil softens what is anointed.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r9.anchor: وهو من الدهن لأنه يلين ما يدهن به

BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r10.claim: Fayudhinūn is coordinated with waddū, not the answer to law; their softness is deceptive, and they delayed it to make Muhammad initiate the compromise.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r10.anchor: لا جواب ( لو ) لأجل تنبيه صلى الله عليه وسلم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r11.claim: As a reported occasion for al-Kāfirūn, the opponents proposed that Muhammad worship their gods for a year while they worshipped his God for a year.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r11.anchor: كما قيل في سبب نزول ( الكافرون )

BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r12.claim: When the Prophet prostrated while reciting al-Najm, disbelievers, believers, jinn, and humans followed; some emigrants in Abyssinia returned believing Quraysh had converted, then found otherwise.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r12.anchor: حتى أنهم سجدوا وراءه صلى الله عليه وسلم لما تلا عليهم سورة النجم فسجد فيها

BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r13.speaker: القشيري
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r13.claim: Al-Qushayrī compares their wish for Muhammad to compromise with a sick person wishing everyone else sick.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r13.anchor: قال القشيري : من أصبح عليلا تمنى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r3.speaker: الكلبي وزيد بن أسلم والحسن
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r3.claim: Al-Kalbī, Zayd ibn Aslam, and al-Ḥasan report that the polytheists wanted the Prophet to stop publicly denouncing them so they would stop harming him and both sides could accommodate each other.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r3.anchor: روي عن الكلبي وزيد بن أسلم والحسن بألفاظ متقاربة تحوم حول أن المشركين ودوا أن يمسك النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r4.claim: Waddū means that they loved or wished for this accommodation.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r5.claim: The wish is not merely private desire disclosed to the Prophet, since that would not fit the command not to obey the deniers.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r5.anchor: وليس المراد أنهم ودوا ذلك في نفوسهم فأطلع الله عليه رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم لعدم مناسبته لقوله

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r6.speaker: كتب السيرة
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r6.claim: Sira books say the polytheists made the Prophet such an offer through his uncle Abū Ṭālib and ʿUtba ibn Rabīʿa.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r6.anchor: وورد في كتب السيرة أن المشركين تقدموا للنبيء صلى الله عليه وسلم بمثل هذا العرض ووسطوا في ذلك عمه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r7.claim: The offer followed the opening verses’ warning: they could stop calling him mad if he stopped humiliating their idols and forebears, leaving each side to its worship.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r7.anchor: فينتظم من هذا أن قوله { فلا تطع المكذبين } نهي عن إجابتهم إلى شيء عرضوه عليه عندما قرعهم بأول هذه السورة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r2.claim: The wish clause explains what the forbidden obedience would consist of, so it is set apart rather than coordinated.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r2.anchor: بيان لمتعلق الطاعة المنهي عنها ولذلك فصلت ولم تعطف

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r3.claim: Tudhin derives from idhān, accommodation or ingratiating softness; literally, applying oil softens or colors something, from which its figurative senses developed, as al-Rāghib notes.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r3.anchor: وفعل { تدهن } مشتق من الإدهان وهو الملاينة والمصانعة ، وحقيقة هذا الفعل أن يجعل لشيء دهنا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r4.claim: They wished the Prophet would accommodate them so they would reciprocate with good treatment.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r4.anchor: أي ودوا منك أن تدهن لهم فيدهنوا لك ، أي لو تواجههم بحسن المعاملة فيواجهونك بمثلها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r5.claim: The fāʾ links the response to “if you accommodate” and explains the consequence or cause of their wish; it does not make the following verb subjunctive.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r5.anchor: والفاء في { فيدهنون } للعطف ، والتسبب عن جملة { لو تدهن } جوابا لمعنى التمني

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r6.claim: An omitted nominal subject, “then they,” precedes the verbal predicate; this fronting restricts accommodation to them and tells the Prophet not to adopt it.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r6.anchor: فالكلام بتقدير مبتدأ محذوف تقديره : فهم يدهنون . وسلك هذا الأسلوب ليكون الاسم المقدر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r7.claim: Law may be conditional, with tudhin as the condition and an omitted result: if the Prophet accommodated them, they would get what they wanted.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r7.anchor: وحرف { لو } يحتمل أن يكون شرطيا ويكون فعل { تدهن } شرطا ، وأن يكون جواب الشرط محذوفا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r8.speaker: الفراء والفارسي والتبريزي وابن مالك
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r8.claim: Al-Farrāʾ, al-Fārisī, al-Tabrīzī, and Ibn Mālik allow law to function as a verbal noun particle like an, yielding “they wished for your accommodation.”
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r8.anchor: على رأي طائفة من علماء العربية أن { لو } يأتي حرفا مصدريا مثل ( أن ) فقد قال بذلك الفراء والفارسي والتبريزي وابن مالك

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r9.claim: The object of waddū is omitted and understood from law tudhin, or it is the verbal noun if law is treated as a maṣdariyya particle.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r9.anchor: ومفعول { ودوا } محذوف دل عليه { لو تدهن } ، أو هو المصدر بناء على أن { لو } تقع حرفا مصدريا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r10.claim: The fāʾ can suggest why they wanted accommodation: they themselves are accommodating, and people with bad intentions want others to resemble them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r10.anchor: وقد يفيد موقع الفاء تعليلا لمودتهم منه أن يدهن ، أي ودوا ذلك منك لأنهم مدهنون

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r19.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r19.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r19.claim: The opponents wanted the Prophet to compromise and incline toward their proposal so they would incline toward his religion; idhan is lenience in what is unlawful, unlike lawful mudaraat.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r19.anchor: وودوا أن يداهنهم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ويميل إلى ما قالوا فيميلوا هم أيضا إلى قوله ودينه، والادهان: الملاينة فيما لا يحل، والمداراة الملاينة فيما يحل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r20.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r20.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r20.claim: The verb فَيُدْهِنُونَ is coordinated with the preceding verb, not a conditional answer, which would be subjunctive.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r20.anchor: وقوله تعالى: فيدهنون معطوف وليس بجواب، لأنه كان ينصب

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r1.claim: The phrase means: if you make concessions, they will make concessions.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r1.anchor: أحدها لو ترخص فيرخصون قاله ابن عباس

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r2.speaker: الحسن
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r2.claim: It means compromising in your religion so they compromise in theirs.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r2.anchor: والثاني لو تصانعهم في دينك فيصانعون في دينهم قاله الحسن

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r3.speaker: عطية، الضحاك، مقاتل
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r3.claim: It means that if you disbelieve, they will disbelieve.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r3.anchor: والثالث لو تكفر فيكفرون قاله عطية والضحاك ومقاتل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r4.speaker: ابن السائب
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r4.claim: It means that if you soften toward them, they will soften toward you.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r4.anchor: والرابع لو تلين فيلينون لك قاله ابن السائب

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r5.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r5.claim: It means dissembling and making a show, which they would reciprocate.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r5.anchor: والخامس لو تنافق وترائي فينافقون ويراؤون قاله زيد بن أسلم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r6.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r6.claim: They wanted religious accommodation: the Prophet should worship their idols for a time and they would worship God for a time.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r6.anchor: وكانوا أرادوه على أن يعبد آلهتهم مدة ويعبدوا الله مدة قاله ابن قتيبة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r7.speaker: أبو عبيدة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r7.claim: Abū ʿUbayda derives the expression from mudāhana, dissembling or obsequiousness.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r7.anchor: وقال أبو عبيدة هو من المداهنة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r8.speaker: ابن كيسان
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r8.claim: It means that if you draw near to them, they will draw near to you.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#3/r8.anchor: والسابع لو تقاربهم فيقاربونك قاله ابن كيسان

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas explains that the deniers wished the Prophet would show them leniency, so they would show him leniency in return.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس: لو ترخص لهم فيرخصون.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r3.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r3.claim: Mujahid says they wished the Prophet would incline toward their idols and abandon the truth he followed.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r3.anchor: وقال مجاهد: ودوا لو تركن إلى آلهتهم وتترك ما أنت عليه من الحق.

JISHUMI:v10p7021/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7021/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7021/r11.claim: Idhān is outward accommodation while concealing enmity; its root compares softened speech to softening with oil. Dāhant means concealment, ad-hant means cheating.
JISHUMI:v10p7021/r11.anchor: شبه التليين في القول بالتليين في الدهن، والمداهنة كالمصانعة يقال: داهنت: إذا واريت، وأدهنت: غششت.

JISHUMI:v10p7022/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7022/r2.speaker: جماعة
JISHUMI:v10p7022/r2.claim: A group says verse 68:9 was revealed about Quraysh polytheists inviting the Prophet to follow their forefathers' religion.
JISHUMI:v10p7022/r2.anchor: قيل: نزل قوله تعالى: (ودوا لو تدهن) الآية، في مشركي قريش حين دعوا إلى دين الآباء، عن جماعة.

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r1.speaker: السدي والضحاك
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r1.claim: The opponents wished the Prophet would disbelieve so they could disbelieve as well.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r1.anchor: أحدها : معناه ودوا لو تكفر فيكفرون , قاله السدي والضحاك .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r2.speaker: أبو جعفر
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r2.claim: They wished he would weaken, so they could weaken too.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r2.anchor: الثاني : ودوا لو تضعف فيضعفون , قاله أبو جعفر .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r3.speaker: الفراء
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r3.claim: They wished he would be accommodating, so they could be accommodating too.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r3.anchor: الثالث : لو تلين فيلينون , قاله الفراء .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r4.speaker: الربيع بن أنس
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r4.claim: They wished he would lie, so they could lie too.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r4.anchor: الرابع : لو تكذب فيكذبون , قاله الربيع بن أنس .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r5.claim: They wished he would make concessions to them, so they would make concessions to him.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r5.anchor: الخامس : لو ترخص لهم فيرخصون لك , قاله ابن عباس .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r6.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r6.claim: They wished he would leave this religious cause, so they would leave it with him.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r6.anchor: السادس : أن تذهب عن هذا الأمر فيذهبون معك , قاله قتادة .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r7.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r7.claim: One sense of mudahana is accommodating and inclining toward an enemy; a cited poem captures this usage.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r7.anchor: أحدهما : مجاملة العدو وممايلته , قال الشاعر : لبعض الغشم أحزم أمور تنوبك من مداهنة العدو .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r8.speaker: المفضل
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r8.claim: Another sense is hypocrisy and abandoning sincere counsel; on this reading mudahana is blameworthy, unlike accommodation.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p62/r8.anchor: الثاني : أنها النفاق وترك المناصحة , قاله المفضل , فهي على هذا الوجه مذمومة , وعلى الوجه الأول غير مذمومة .

MUQATIL:68:7-12/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:68:7-12/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:68:7-12/r4.claim: They wished Muhammad would disbelieve, so they too could disbelieve rather than believe.
MUQATIL:68:7-12/r4.anchor: ودوا لو تكفر يا محمد، فيكفرون فلا يؤمنون

NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#8/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#8/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#8/r1.claim: They wished the Prophet would soften toward them so they would soften toward him.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#8/r1.anchor: لو تلين لهم ﴿ فيدهنون ﴾ فيلينون لك

NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#8/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#8/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#8/r2.claim: The verb is not subjunctive with an implied “أن” as a response to a wish; the construction instead reports that they already soften in hope he will compromise.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#8/r2.anchor: ولم ينصب باضمار أن وهو جواب التمني لأنه عدل به إلى طريق آخر

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r1.speaker: ابن عباس، عطية، الضحاك، السدي
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas, Atiyya, al-Dahhak, and al-Suddi say the opponents wished the Prophet would disbelieve, so they could persist in disbelief.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس وعطية والضحاك والسدي: ودوا لو تكفر فيتمادون على كفرهم.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas also says they wished the Prophet would make concessions to them so they could make concessions to him.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r2.anchor: وعن ابن عباس أيضا: ودوا لو ترخص لهم فيرخصون لك.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r3.speaker: الفراء والكلبي
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r3.claim: Al-Farra and al-Kalbi gloss the phrase as softening toward them so that they soften toward the Prophet.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r3.anchor: وقال الفراء والكلبي: لو تلين فيلينون لك.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r4.speaker: الفراء
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r4.claim: Al-Farra explains idhān as softening toward someone who should not be treated softly.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r4.anchor: والادهان: التليين لمن لا ينبغي له التليين قاله الفراء.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r5.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r5.claim: Mujahid says they wished the Prophet would incline toward them and abandon the truth, so they would accommodate him.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r5.anchor: وقال مجاهد: المعنى ودوا لو ركنت إليهم وتركت الحق فيمالئونك.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r6.speaker: الربيع بن أنس
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r6.claim: Al-Rabi ibn Anas says they wished the Prophet would lie, so they would lie in return.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r6.anchor: وقال الربيع بن أنس: ودوا لو تكذب فيكذبون.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r7.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r7.claim: Qatada says they wished the Prophet would leave this mission, so they could accompany him in doing so.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r7.anchor: وقال قتادة: ودوا لو تذهب عن هذا الأمر فيذهبون معك.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r8.speaker: الحسن
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r8.claim: Al-Hasan says they wished the Prophet would compromise them in religion, so they would compromise him in theirs.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r8.anchor: الحسن: ودوا لو تصانعهم في دينك فيصانعونك في دينهم.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r9.speaker: الحسن
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r9.claim: Al-Hasan also glosses it as wishing the Prophet would relinquish part of his message so they would relinquish part of theirs.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r9.anchor: وعنه أيضا: ودوا لو ترفض بعض أمرك فيرفضون بعض أمرهم.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r10.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r10.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam says they wished the Prophet would dissemble and show them a false face, so they could do likewise.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r10.anchor: زيد بن أسلم: لو تنافق وترائي فينافقون ويراءون.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r11.speaker: أبو جعفر
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r11.claim: Abu Jaafar says they wished the Prophet would weaken, so they too would weaken.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r11.anchor: وقيل: ودوا لو تضعف فيضعفون قاله أبو جعفر.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r12.speaker: القتبي
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r12.claim: Al-Qutaybi says they wished the Prophet would flatter them in religion, so they would flatter him in theirs.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r12.anchor: وقيل، ودوا لو تداهن في دينك فيداهنون في أديانهم قاله القتبي.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r13.speaker: القتبي
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r13.claim: Al-Qutaybi further reports that they asked the Prophet to worship their gods for a period and then they would worship his God for a period.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r13.anchor: وعنه: طلبوا منه أن يعبد آلهتهم مدة ويعبدوا إلهه مدة.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r14.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r14.claim: Ibn al-Arabi says commentators offered about ten claims grounded in language and meaning, and considers wishing the Prophet would lie or disbelieve the strongest.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r14.anchor: ابن العربي: ذكر المفسرون فيها نحو عشرة أقوال كلها دعاوى على اللغة والمعنى. أمثلها قولهم: ودوا لو تكذب

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r15.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r15.claim: Qurtubi rejects Ibn al-Arabi's narrowing: he regards all the listed explanations as sound under the language and meaning, since idhān means softness and accommodation.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r15.anchor: قلت: كلها إن شاء الله تعالى صحيحة على مقتضى اللغة والمعنى فإن الادهان: اللين والمصانعة.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r16.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r16.claim: Other glosses define mudāhana as accommodating or leaning toward an enemy, or as approaching and softening speech; a cited poem contrasts flattery with oppression.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r16.anchor: وقيل: مجاملة العدو ممايلته. وقيل: المقاربة في الكلام والتليين في القول. قال الشاعر: لبعض الغشم أحزم في أمور

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r17.speaker: المفضل
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r17.claim: Al-Mufaddal defines idhān as hypocrisy and abandoning sincere counsel; Qurtubi says it is blameworthy in this sense, unlike the first, and none of these acts occurred.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r17.anchor: وقال المفضل: النفاق وترك المناصحة. فهي على هذا الوجه مذمومة، وعلى الوجه الأول غير مذمومة

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r18.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r18.speaker: المبرد
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r18.claim: Al-Mubarrad says adhana in religion and dāhana in a matter mean betraying it and outwardly showing the opposite of one's inward state.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r18.anchor: قال المبرد: يقال أدهن في دينه وداهن في أمره أي خان فيه وأظهر خلاف ما يضمر.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r19.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r19.speaker: الجوهري
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r19.claim: Al-Jawhari distinguishes dāhana, meaning to conceal or dissimulate, from adhana, meaning to cheat.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r19.anchor: وقال قوم: داهنت بمعنى واريت، وأدهنت بمعنى غششت قاله الجوهري.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r20.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r20.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r20.claim: The indicative fa-yudh'inūna is coordinated with the preceding verb; as a response to the prohibition it would be subjunctive jussive fa-yudh'inū.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r20.anchor: وقال: «فيدهنون» فساقه على العطف، ولو جاء به جواب النهي لقال فيدهنوا.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r21.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r21.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r21.claim: The coordination depicts their wish that the Prophet act as they do and they then imitate him; it is comparison, not a consequence or recompense.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:9/r21.anchor: وإنما أراد: إن تمنوا لو فعلت فيفعلون مثل فعلك عطفا لا جزاء عليه ولا مكافأة، وإنما هو تمثيل وتنظير.
